task: ae.sf: IEEE-754 binary64 soft-float (add/sub/mul/div/sqrt/fma, conversions) with exact decimal parsing and shortest round-trip formatting, differentially tested against the JDK
reasoning_summary: Every finite operation unpacks to an exact BigInteger mantissa/exponent, computes the exact result (sticky bit appended for division and sqrt) and rounds once to nearest-even, so correctness reduces to one rounding routine. Decimal parsing reuses that rounding on exact ratios; shortest printing searches n-digit floor/ceil candidates against the exact rounding interval. A first run failed because the lower interval boundary was treated as a power-of-two edge for every normal number; fixed by testing m == 2^52, then all 27 tests passed and 16/16 non-equivalent mutants were killed.
